description_zh: Waymo AV 在手动模式下右转进入 Pacific Avenue 时，右后轮与一辆停在路边停车场入口处的重型卡车的 lowered loading lift 发生侧擦碰撞。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was making a right turn to travel west on Pacific Avenue. As the Waymo AV turned, the rear right tire of the Waymo AV made contact with the lowered loading lift of a heavy truck parked partially across the parking lot entrance.
evidence.reason: AV 正在移动并右转，具有测试价值；卡车静止在路边，可用 static_block 表达。
